knownIssues.testName: UI-052: A visitor with no cart sees the empty cart message
knownIssues.description: Known issue BUG-049: The Cart step of the checkout shows nothing (no message, table or button) for a visitor without a cart, instead of "Your shopping cart is empty".

knownIssues.testName: UI-053: Deleting the last line shows the empty cart message
knownIssues.description: Known issue BUG-050: The Cart step of the checkout says "The cart is empty. Nothing to display." instead of "Your shopping cart is empty" after the last line is deleted.

knownIssues.testName: UI-084: A rental line in the checkout cart is marked "This is a rental item"
knownIssues.description: Known issue BUG-051: The checkout cart marks a rental line "Item for rent, price per hour" instead of "This is a rental item".

knownIssues.testName: UI-062: A logged-in customer sees the already-signed-in message on the sign-in step
knownIssues.description: Known issue BUG-048: The sign-in step tells a logged-in customer "Hello <first> <last>, you are already logged in." instead of "You are already signed in as <first> <last>".

knownIssues.testName: UI-024: A typed quantity above 999,999,999 is set to 999,999,999
knownIssues.description: Known issue BUG-008: The field sets a typed quantity above 99 to 99 (with the warning "You can order at most 99 of this product.") instead of setting 1,000,000,000 to 999,999,999 as the story's range 1 to 999,999,999 requires.

knownIssues.testName: UI-025: A typed quantity of 999,999,999 is accepted
knownIssues.description: Known issue BUG-008: The field changes a typed quantity of 999,999,999 to 99 (the app allows at most 99) instead of keeping it as the story's range 1 to 999,999,999 requires.
